column7: The per-IP login budget (and, since #3029, the password_reset and sso_begin budgets) failed OPEN when CountRecentLoginAttempts errored while ReserveLoginAttempt/RecordLoginAttempt succeeded: n was taken as 0 and memory held only failed writes, so the IP was never limited. Successful writes made while the budget is degraded are now mirrored in memory and a failed count is judged on memory including mirrors (a working count ignores them: TestAuthBudget_CountOnlyFailure_RecoveryDoesNotDoubleCount; a delivered login releases the mirror with its row: _DeliveredLoginReleasesItsMirror). Red on #3023 @ 670e1163: 100 of 100 attempts allowed. #3023 review (opus, finding 1); #3029 review at bf0ff420 (finding 1).
